prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Master Desktop Controls & Hotkeys", "Use Ctrl+Shift+P to summon or hide your pet anytime, or right-click the tray icon for quick actions.", "Ctrl+Shift+P to Toggle Pet | Right-Click Tray to Sleep", "Got It, Launch Pet"]
1: ["Official Adoption Certificate", "Give your new desktop companion a name to complete the adoption process.", "Companion Name", "Confirm Name & Adopt"]
2: ["Your Pet is Arriving on Desktop!", "Look at the bottom corner of your primary monitor as your pet settles into its new home.", "See Pet on Desktop"]
3: ["Save Your New Pet to Your Account", "Sign in now to sync your adoption certificate and preserve your companion across devices."]
4: ["Pick an Express Starter Companion", "Choose a popular pet style instantly, or customize details later in settings.", "Playful Shiba | Cozy Calico | Mini Dragon"]
5: ["Preparing Desktop Environment...", "Your pet will appear near your taskbar shortly. Keep an eye out for a quiet chirp sound.", "Check the system tray icon if your pet ever wanders off-screen.", "Taskbar & Tray Audio Ready"]
6: ["Welcome to Your Desktop Pet!", "Your pet is active! You can click and drag to move it anywhere on screen.", "Double-click your pet to open quick actions, or press Esc to hide it temporarily.", "Pro-tip: Right-click the pet or system tray icon for full settings."]
7: ["Select Your Onboarding Path", "Pick how you want to create your pet today."]
8: ["Sign In to Preserve Your Companion", "Connecting an account ensures your pet's progress and custom items are saved safely.", "Automatic Cloud Save Enabled"]
9: ["Upload Pet Photo for Custom Creation", "Upload a clear photo, or pick from our curated companion templates if generation fails.", "Instant Template Fallback Ready"]
